title: Ulyana and the Colony Revisited
author: Oscar Vane
blurb: Vesper Eriksen, a clone who inherited the original's murder case, has spent five years hauling cargo through contested orbits. Then an unfamiliar name shows up on the manifest of a ship that never flew — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must decide which half of humanity wakes from cryosleep, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
